comments.author: wdavidw

comments.body:
I checked the current `csv-parse` source (7.0.3, commit `1500f7ce`) with the options above on Node 22.22.3. I couldn't reproduce the chunk-boundary failure:

- A synthetic 51-column table with BOM, multibyte text, and quoted delimiters passed all 1,702 two-chunk byte boundaries, plus 128 fixed-size Buffer/Uint8Array chunk layouts.
- A larger 850-row, 51-column table passed 16 layouts, including one-byte chunks and 8/16/64 KiB chunks.

This does not rule out a data-dependent failure in the original input. Could you share an anonymized failing CSV sample and the chunk lengths that trigger it? That would let us distinguish delimiter buffering from quoting or input-format issues.
